summary: Configured node1 to persist nameserver 10.100.120.1 and use infra.test as its system search domain. Both settings survived a full node restart, and DNS resolution recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Added an eth0-specific persistent DNS policy to /etc/dhcpcd.conf.
Reloaded dhcpcd and verified the live resolver configuration.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified networking, SSH, time synchronization, management connectivity, and DNS resolution after restart.

evidence.summary: Captured the originally supplied nameserver 10.100.120.1, installed it as a static dhcpcd DNS value, and confirmed it remained active after restart.

evidence.requirement: Add infra.test as the system search domain
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent domain_search policy, live search entry, and post-restart resolver state.
Documents the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from 3152f68d-4d7a-4cd5-be87-ad27680f0b88 to 83b17179-67c3-40a0-b436-58d69e48ecf6, and complete service/network/DNS recovery.
